mod.overview: Tribes Racer: Retribution v3.0 (Josef Jahn / PlaySpoon, December 1999, TribesRacer.cs) uses Base Tribes physics and 52 stock datablocks while uncapping vehicle team limits to 64 per team and turning maps into sequential checkpoint races.
notes: TribesRacer.cs sets $TeamItemMax to 64 for Scout, LAPC, and HAPC so all racers can spawn vehicles freely, sequences vehicle::leg1/leg2/leg3 gates via TowerSwitch/GroupTrigger collisions, places persistent next-checkpoint waypoints on the HUD, and scores fastest laps.
